dict.string: MyWizard reads your synced calendars to let you choose a meeting title and invited people for your local transcription. It does not change calendar events.
MyWizard transcribes system and microphone audio locally and displays the text in a floating window.
MyWizard records your microphone locally on a separate audio track and adds its transcription under your saved name when preparing the final export. Microphone speech is never read aloud.
MyWizard transcribes system audio locally and can mute the original sound while reading the transcript aloud.
